dct_title_s: Indonesia Floods: Flood Proxy Maps, Jan 2023
dct_description_sm: # Indonesia Floods: Flood Proxy Maps, Jan 2023 The **Earth Observatory of Singapore – Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS)** produced these flood proxy maps for Indonesia Floods (Jan 2023) from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite images. Each map is a separate ZIP below with its GeoTIFF, a KMZ for Google Earth, the PNG figures and a text file describing how it was made and how to read it. ## Maps in this dataset - **EOS-RS Flood Proxy Map: South Sulawesi, Indonesia, Floods, 4 Jan 2023, v0.7** - **EOS-RS Flood Proxy Map: South Sulawesi, Indonesia, Floods, 4 Jan 2023, v0.3** (superseded) **More map details and files:** **More map details and files:** **Credits:** Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS), Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2022-2023)
